title: Money
description: Every amount on the wire. Integer minor units plus an ISO 4217 code (spec money_rules). The number of minor units per major unit comes from the currency exponent served in the country pack (UGX = 0), never from a hardcoded /100. Clients display amounts; they never derive commission, fees, payouts or referral amounts from them. PREVIEW, not binding: contracts v1 (Stage B) may add fields but will not change these two.

amount_minor.description: Signed integer in minor units. Stays within ±9007199254740991 so JavaScript clients read it exactly.
